messages:
Sasha: Heads-up — vendor just pushed our H100 EU shipment ETA from 2024-04-22 -> 2024-05-08. They say it's a carrier routing change and customs sloting. We need a quick call: do we accept split shipments (EU partial now, rest later), or consolidate and pay expedite? Also need RMA labels for DOA replacements and confirmation of transit insurance coverage.

Marc: Can you post the AWB(s) and any carrier notes? Need to model cost delta if we expedite.

Sasha: AWB(s) from vendor below and vendor note. They also flagged HS/commodity marking as `HS:847350` for customs (EU).
```
AWB: 123-45678901
Carrier: AirBridge Express
Routing note: partial split at FRA due to ULD backfill
Tracking: https://carrier.example/track/123-45678901
```

Alex: If carrier can't add insurance at origin, we should pre-buy insurance for the EU leg. Quick estimation: added prem = ~$1,800 for the partial pallet vs $3,200 to expedite a consolidated overnight. I lean split + insurance unless product arrival window critical for customer SLAs.

Jenna: From customs experience, splitting reduces hold risk per shipment but increases paperwork. For EU, keeping smaller entries with correct HS helps clear faster. I'd vote split. :thumbsup:

OpsBot: NexaSupply update (automated): vendor confirms partial split possible. They uploaded provisional AWBs and said RMA labels will be provided as PDF after serial audit.
```
Vendor note: partial-split confirmed; RMA labels pending serial audit; ETA (EU leg): 2024-05-08
```

Marc: Okay — provisional plan: reserve 4 H100s for EU (split 1) and keep 2 for US batch. Jenna — can you take lead on customs entries? Alex — please request the vendor produce the serial audit CSV and RMA PDFs. I'll model cost-share if expedite needed.

Sasha: Agreed. Also confirm: if vendor doesn't provide RMA labels within 24h, vendor pays outbound DOA shipping. We'll escalate contract clause 3.2.

Alex: Requesting serial audit now. Sending example CSV header to vendor so they know format:
```
serial_number,sku,shipment_awb,condition,checked_by,checked_at
```

Jenna: Noted on entries. For the EU allocation I'll prepare the EORI and commercial invoice template. One ask: vendor to confirm declared value for insurance purposes (we'll need invoice value + freight).

Marc: For expedite decision: if vendor confirms insurance + RMA labels in 24h, we keep split. If not, we consolidate and pay for expedite to keep customer SLAs — estimate $3,200. Approve cost-share 60/40 (Redwood/vendor) if consolidation required.

Sasha: Assigning actions — @Jenna handle customs docs & EU entries; @Alex chase serial audit & RMA PDFs; I'll hold allocations and update capacity planning. OpsBot, can you open a PO/RMA ticket referencing contract clause for accountability? :eyes: 

OpsBot: Ticket #2345 created: "Vendor partial-split, serial audit pending, request RMA labels & insurance confirmation". Vendor notified; ETA for vendor reply: 24h. I'll post updates here when received.

Marc: Thanks. One last thing — verify whether vendor will consolidate packaging (foam inserts) differently for split shipments; that affects DOA inspection throughput. Short call this afternoon if anyone needs to sync.

Sasha: Good point. If we get the RMA PDFs we should confirm foam/packaging photos. If vendor refuses, we escalate to procurement for holdback.

Jenna: I'll queue a customs checklist and include packaging/packing list requirement.

Alex: I'll ping vendor now.

Sasha: Thanks everyone. Will update when OpsBot posts vendor reply. :white_check_mark:
